comments.body: Could this guard and `getObs_shouldNotThrowWhenTheObsDirGlobalPropertyHasNoValue` go in their own ticket? Master throws the same NPE here for a bare-extension title whenever the obs dir property is unset, image present or not, so it's a separate fix from the I/O counts, and keeping it out leaves less to verify here. Nothing breaks with it in.

This can just delegate to `getDataWithMetadata`, which repeats the same GetObject call and 404 translation (the kind of duplication ibacher flagged in `LocalStorageService`, [comment](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-core/pull/6535#discussion_r3990739410)), since the GET already carries the headers:

```suggestion
		return getDataWithMetadata(key).data();
```
